items:
A work permit must be issued and the 
 qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor.

Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor.

The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.

Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained.

Complete maintenance tool 
 set.

Cleaning fluid, Manual 
 puller.

Feeler gauge, Dial 
 indicator.

Vibrometer, Straight 
 edge, Rags.

Measure vibrations level for bearings and 
 compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine what to do.

Check discharge quantity and pressure and 
 compare them with the setting value then replace the worn-out components.

Check alignment and compare it with the 
 setting value.

Measure vibrations level for bearings and 
 compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine what to do 
 (if it is needed).

Check discharge pressure and compare it with 
 the setting value then replace the worn- out components (if it is needed).

Check bolts fixation, then re-tight it (if it 
 is needed).

Make test for bearings oil and add or change 
 it (if it is needed).

Check glands for leaking and replace it if it 
 is needed.
Check flanges for leaking.

Check the pump casing against rust and 
 re-paint (if it is needed).

Introduction
This document outlines 
 the the equipment Inspection I1, to be performed every six months as indicated 
 by M6 in the above title block.
This pump is used for 
 cooling the hydrogen of generator.
Technical specification
Type of pump: | 150-NHD-400-38-Meta 36
Design: | Horizontal centrifugal pump
Pump capacity: | 268 t/h
Height | 33 m
Pump Speed | 1475 r.p.m.
Bearing Type: | 6321
The first draft initiated & 
 tested by eng. Amr Farouk Rabee, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gelil,

Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the 
 qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy,

 breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor.
The pump must be isolated

Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool 
 set.
Cleaning fluid, Manual 
 puller.
Feeler gauge, Dial 
 indicator.
Vibrometer, Straight 
 edge, Rags.
Work to be carried out
Pump in Operation
Measure vibrations level for bearings and 
 compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine what to do.
Check discharge quantity and pressure and 
 compare them with the setting value then replace the worn-out components.
Pump out of Operation
Check alignment and compare it with the 
 setting value.
Measure vibrations level for bearings and 
 compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine what to do 
 (if it is needed).
Check discharge pressure and compare it with 
 the setting value then replace the worn- out components (if it is needed).
Check bolts fixation, then re-tight it (if it 
 is needed).
Make test for bearings oil and add or change 
 it (if it is needed).
Check glands for leaking and replace it if it 
 is needed.
Check flanges for leaking.
Check the pump casing against rust and 
 re-paint (if it is needed).
